text: I like this app! The reason I won't give 5 stars or subscribe is due to the rigid tracking. For example, you've set a goal of 5000 steps a day but on 3 days you hit 7000. The app won't accept anything higher than 5000. Ironically, this can impact motivation. Seeing days where a goal is exceeded motivates the user to do more. BONUS: Let the app coach users. If we exceed a habit goal by 60% or more for 30 days, encourage users to set higher goals like a coach would. I'd subscribe for that. 🙂
